newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union to float on exchange - paper.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union to float on exchange - paper.

text.p: Norwich Union, Britain's second-biggest mutual insurance company, will formally announce in the next two weeks that it will float on the London Stock Exchange next summer, the Times daily newspaper reported in its Monday edition.
It said the company would give bonuses averaging 700 pounds to its three million with-profits policyholders after the 400 billion sterling flotation.

The conversion, likely to be in June, would have to be approved by a vote at an extraordinary meeting of policyholders, the newspaper said. It said Norwich Union was looking for a big-enough venue to accomodate the flotation.
